sources.evidence: wined3dmapflags_from_ddrawmapflags removes READ permission for WRITEONLY; only DISCARD denotes discard semantics. This is Wine implementation evidence, not a frozen Microsoft HAL observation.

reference.scope: S2-48: WRITEONLY grants write access without discarding prior GPU content. Synchronize the dirty shared shadow before handing out any lock pointer, including WRITEONLY, so uploading a complete locked rectangle preserves untouched pixels. Validate bounds and compressed alignment first. Failed readback returns GENERIC without changing output, lock depth, flags or rectangle; retry remains possible. Native actual full Lock/Unlock: 7648 checks and 768 full/partial locks across read/write, READONLY and WRITEONLY, aliases, compressed pointer offsets, refusal isolation and readback failure/retry; ten strict-compiled runtime mutations, previous-source runtime control and ASan/UBSan. XP actual DD1/2/3/4/7 surface views execute ten full/partial WRITEONLY modifications plus three transport-failure/retry modifications, twelve surfaces and exact final release. CPU replies are explicit independent intent data; stale-id, failed and short-size replies are injected only on the XP CPU transport. No CPU reply is claimed as real GPU validation. GPU replay validates all 29 actual successful readback responses and 464 RGBA pixels, including thirteen final modifications with fifteen untouched pixels each. Invalid CPU-reply requests remain valid GPU requests during replay. No new primary Present, native HAL, gameplay/FPS, P8/BC GPU pixel proofs, GetDC failure policy, nested lock redesign, S2-49 through S2-55/S2-57, general ownership/conversion or review stages 4/5/6 completion. D3D8/9, host/protocol/shaders/bundle unchanged.
